name: Bring postal code
description: Client-side postal-code lookup that fills locality fields from Bring's free postcode service.
project_description:
This module fills in localities on the client side based on results from Bring 's postal code service. The Bring postal code service is free, but has a volume limit.

 

 This module can sit on top of any form. Node, taxonomy, order in checkout, custom form, anything. Just configure a set of selectors for where the data is to be filled in, plus a form ID, and you are set to go. Since it is entirely javascript-driven, it does not validate server side.
